notes: GameDevelopmentBot V0.29: picture -> 3D model, now more reliable in chat (it always runs the real 3D generator for your picture and frees the graphics card first). Give it a picture of one object (PNG/JPG) and it builds a textured 3D model (GLB + FBX, copied into your Unity project) on your own GPU - NVIDIA or AMD with 8 GB VRAM. The first time, a one-time background setup (about 20 GB, ~25 GB free disk) picks the right build for your graphics card. Needs 16 GB RAM with the Windows pagefile on (32 GB recommended). Powered by Tencent Hunyuan3D 2 (Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 Community License). GameDevelopmentBot is not available in the EU, UK or South Korea.
